This should be only an output parameter here.
Applies to other instances as well.
In case error message is set. No need to throw. The error code should carry the message to the caller and based on that caller can decide.
We can have only one declared at the top?
Do we need uint16? or uint8 should suffice?
We need uint16 because error codes 1001 exceed the maximum value (255) of uint8.
In this case now we need to check for error code and log accordingly.

as we are not checking returned value is empty and error code, we miss actual error and only log "Mandatory tag(s) missing from JSON" always, which was not the case earlier.

same for below calls as well.

will update this via another commit. Currently this commit updates only the getVPDOffset and getInventoryObjPathFromJson APIs.

updated the APIs to log message based on the error code.
Please push this as a separate commit.
